transformer.name: pinecone:embeddings
transformer.title: Pinecone (Embeddings)
transformer.description: Prepares the message to become an object writable by Pinecone component

transformerIn.description: A LangChain4j TextSegment, or a String the converter of camel-langchain4j-embeddings turns into one, whose text goes in the text_segment field of the CamelPineconeMetadata header, which UPSERT and UPDATE store with the vector; another body stores no text. The vector comes from the CamelLangChain4jEmbeddingsVector header, which must be set
